test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Boil the ocean
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 **i.e. **Try to do something impossible.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Boil the ocean"** means to undertake an impossible task or project or to make a task or project unnecessarily difficult.
 
• The correct phrase **"Try to do something impossible"** reflects undertaking tasks that are beyond one's capacity or are inherently unfeasible. 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Try to do something impossible.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Something very big** refers to something of large size or extent but doesn't necessarily relate to the difficulty or impossibility of a task.
 
• **Option 2: Something which gets hot gradually** suggests a process of gradual increase in temperature or intensity, not related to undertaking challenging tasks.
 
• **Option 4: To make someone very angry** refers to provoking anger in someone, which is unrelated to the concept of attempting an impossible task.
